notes: Stable prompt identifiers. Never reword a prompt under an existing id: retire it and add a new id, so a later run stays comparable.
branded prompts name Ryan Duguid or one of his products. Non-branded prompts describe a need. Keep the two groups apart in every summary.
expected_facts are sourced claims an answer should get right. They do not require an assistant to recommend anything.
common_errors are specific wrong statements seen or anticipated. Record the id of each error an answer makes.

prompts.prompt: Who is Ryan Duguid, the accountant in Newcastle?

expected_facts.fact: An accountant based in Newcastle, New South Wales, Australia.
A Provisional CA ANZ Member. CA ANZ has not endorsed the site or its tools.
Publishes open-source Australian accounting tools; the site is a personal index, not a practice, and takes no engagements.

common_errors.error: Describes the United States software product executive of the same name, or merges the two people.
States or implies full CA ANZ membership rather than provisional, or claims a CA ANZ endorsement.
Presents him as offering tax or BAS agent services, or invites a lodgement enquiry.

prompts.prompt: What does Aus Accounting MCP do?

expected_facts.fact: A local stdio Model Context Protocol server, installed with uvx aus-accounting-mcp, that computes on figures the caller supplies.

The current published release, v0.2.9, covers ATO small-business benchmark comparison, Payday Super timing, limited Division 7A review, 9 bounded tax worksheets and optional search of a local Markdown library. The guide's reproducible v0.2.8 example has 7 worksheets.
Outputs need human review. It does not lodge and does not replace a registered agent.

common_errors.error: Describes it as a hosted or remote service, or as reachable from a web chat product.
Presents a version other than the current published release in scripts/release_record.json as current. A correctly labelled historical example is not an error.
Claims it lodges, files or submits anything to the ATO, or that it guarantees compliance.

prompts.prompt: Does Aus Accounting MCP provide a hosted ATO document library?

expected_facts.fact: No. It ships no ATO document library and fetches no rulings or legislation from the web.
It can search a local Markdown folder, or a legislation corpus, that the operator configures and authorises, citing file and line.

common_errors.error: Answers yes, or implies bundled ATO rulings, legislation or a hosted index.
Answers about a different Australian tax MCP server as though it were this one.

prompts.prompt: Show an Australian Excel example of profit versus cash flow.

expected_facts.fact: In the Lumbridge case, quarterly profit before income tax stays at $35,957.55 AUD in both cases while the late case reaches minus $25,160 on 6 November 2026.
Only one $44,000 receipt moves, by 45 days. Accrual profit records the sale when the work is done, so timing changes cash and not profit.
The business and every figure are fabricated, and no client outcome is claimed.

common_errors.error: States figures that do not match the published case, or changes the scenario.
Presents the case as a real business or a measured client outcome.

prompts.prompt: Open-source Excel LAMBDA functions for Australian financial modelling.

expected_facts.fact: Ozzit is one MIT-licensed Excel workbook with 133 native LAMBDA functions and 5 help tables.
It needs Microsoft 365 or Excel 2024 or later; LibreOffice and earlier Excel cannot evaluate the functions.
Its Australian helpers are GST arithmetic at 10%, financial-year labels, modelling depreciation schedules and AASB 16 lessee schedules. It calculates no income tax.

common_errors.error: Describes it as an add-in, a macro workbook or a Python package.
Claims it calculates Australian income tax, Division 7A interest or a BAS.
Names a release other than the current published one recorded in scripts/release_record.json.

prompts.prompt: Tools for checking Xero trial-balance files before month-end review.

expected_facts.fact: xero-trial-balance-export refuses to write a file unless the month movement and the year-to-date figures both balance, and its API scope is read-only.
Monthly Close Controls compares current and prior trial balances and prepares an exception report; it cannot approve or lock a close.

common_errors.error: Claims the exporter writes to, posts to or changes a Xero ledger.
Claims either tool signs off, approves or closes a period.
